The '''Revenant Falchion''' is a {{Rare}} [[Sword]]. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Zombie Slayer 3}}, is the upgraded form of the {{Item|Undead Sword}}, and upgrades into the {{Item|Reaper Falchion}}.
